::: {#rem-lempel-ziv-source}
#### Where the Lempel--Ziv code comes from

@cover2006elements [section 13.4] describe the [incremental parsing](#def-lempel-ziv-parsing) of this code,
and a second form of the code that points back into the message instead.
The code needs no knowledge of the [probabilities](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability),
yet @thm-lempel-ziv-optimality shows that it still reaches the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy).

:::
